review_priorities.reason: The conversion can reference multiple component groups or lack an unambiguous mapping.
The converter itself reports outstanding manual implementation and verification work.
Static counts and field references do not establish required outcomes, errors or side effects.
Execution equivalence must be determined by independent observation rather than assumptions.
External dependencies and secrets remain omitted from the public candidate.

KnownLimitations: The XML exports remain confidential and are not included in output.
Generated topology is not an implementation conformance result.
Evidence from source-code text is reduced to allowlisted categories and counters.
Source connector transport family may be OTHER_OR_UNRESOLVED.
